Requirements

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of software development experience
  • Strong proficiency with C#, .NET
  • Experience with SQL (Microsoft SQL Server)
  • Back-end oriented background building and maintaining APIs, services, and data-access layers within established, potentially complex systems
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code)
  • Experience with Git or a similar version-control system
  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum teams
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with cross-functional teammates
  • Strong communication skills in both spoken and written English

What makes you stand out

Ownership from development through production

  • Solid professional experience developing software with C# and .NET.
  • Doesn't simply code a ticket and hand it off.
  • Takes responsibility for getting work through development → code review → QA → deployment → production.
  • Demonstrates a history of reliably delivering assigned work and following through on commitments.

Strong communication & collaboration

  • Communicates proactively with teammates, Product, and QA.
  • Raises blockers rather than going quiet when stuck.
  • Comfortable asking questions and seeking help when working through unfamiliar or complex systems.
  • Communicates early when an issue could affect delivery.

AI-assisted development

  • Experience using AI-assisted software development tools such as Claude Code or similar platforms.
  • Understands how to use AI tools responsibly to improve development and testing productivity.

Nice-to-haves

  • Startup experience
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure is preferred (AWS or another cloud platform is also valuable)
  • Experience with CI/CD, DevOps practices
  • Front-end experience (React, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS)
  • Experience in troubleshooting and supporting production applications
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent

What you will work on

  • Build, maintain, and troubleshoot backend applications using C#, .NET
  • Design and implement backend services, APIs, and database interactions
  • Write and optimize SQL queries, stored procedure,s and database logic using Microsoft SQL Server
  • Own assigned tasks from development through code review, QA, deployme,nt and release
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application and production issues
  • Support production deployments and assist when issues come up
  • Independently own small-to-medium backend features and fixes
  • Write clean, maintainable code that passes peer review
  • Quickly become productive within the existing codebase and development environment
  • Take part in two-week Agile/Scrum sprints, including planning, estimation, stand,ups and retrospectives
  • Prioritize and execute a backlog of feature requests, enhancem,ents and bug fixes within sprint cycles
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, Product O,wners and QA
  • Take part in peer code reviews and technical discussions
  • Communicate proactively on progress, blockers,, risks and timelines
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and cloud-based deployment practices
  • Use AI-assisted tools to improve development and testing workflows
  • Work within a Microsoft-based tech stack, relational databases, cloud infrast,ructure and modern development tooling
